purpose: Document city-local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Official Zanzibar Assembly material from the Ministry of Lands reports that the Land Commission verified and registered land parcels in Mjini (Urban) and Magharibi districts, establishing city-local registration activity. Current Ministry materials describe title registration and surveying/mapping, while LARIS was only launched in July 2026 with aerial imagery collection beginning. No current public parcel map/vector source was found. The Zanzibar Land Administration and Registration Information System (LARIS) is newly launched and aerial survey collection has begun; no public parcel query/viewer or vector endpoint is documented. The Shehia Register is role-authenticated planning/community data for buildings and boundaries, not a legal cadastral parcel layer. No login or parcel query was attempted.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar Ministry of Lands and Housing page describes land title registration, land surveying and mapping, and the Commission of Lands role.

Official Ministry of Lands budget/speech report describes Commission of Lands verification and registration of parcels in Mjini and Magharibi districts. Only district-level aggregate activity was used; no parcel/person-level data was copied.

Official Zanzibar Planning Commission Shehia Register describes a role-authenticated spatial register of buildings, boundaries and community data. It is not documented as a land-title cadastral parcel map; login page only, no login attempted.
Official Zanzibar land-law compilation establishes the statutory registry and Registry Map framework by registration district; it does not identify a public online vector service.
